summary: This note is a documentation page for the FACTORIAL function, which computes the factorial of an integer input. The input must be an integer expression in the range 0 to 33. The page gives the syntax FACTORIAL( <integer_expr> ) and an example query returning factorials of 0, 1, 5 and 10. The surrounding navigation, feedback prompt and footer text are boilerplate.
one_line: Documentation for the FACTORIAL function, which computes an integer's factorial for inputs from 0 to 33.
key_facts: FACTORIAL computes the factorial of its input.
The input argument of FACTORIAL must be an integer expression in the range of 0 to 33.
The syntax of FACTORIAL is FACTORIAL( <integer_expr> ).
The example query is SELECT FACTORIAL(0), FACTORIAL(1), FACTORIAL(5), FACTORIAL(10);
